verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the GitHub README say PlayCanvas is built on WebGL2 and WebGPU, runs in any browser, and falls back from WebGPU to WebGL automatically based on browser support. That covers both 'WebGL today' and a credible WebGPU story. Community comments call it lightweight and a sensible choice when the web is the target. missing for 10: concrete payload or bundle-size figures, independent hands-on benchmarks of WebGPU maturity.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story

citations.quote: PlayCanvas is an open-source game engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU. Use it to create interactive 3D apps, games and visualizations that run in any browser on any device.
The engine will seamlessly fall back from WebGPU to WebGL based on browser support.
pretty lightweight, but still comes with a nice scene editor etc.
